description: Broadcasting House is the headquarters and registered office of the BBC in Portland Place, London, England, UK. It is home to BBC Radio 3, BBC Radio 4, and BBC 7. At the front of the building are statues of Prospero and Ariel (from Shakespeare's The Tempest) by Eric Gill.
